# Kinetic Gain Protocol Suite

> Canonical front door for the entire 11-spec open AI governance suite + 15-repo implementation stack.

The official landing page for the Kinetic Gain Protocol Suite. **11 open JSON specifications** spanning entity declaration, prompt lineage, agent disclosure, citation evidence, tool disclosure, plus an EdTech trio (vendor / district / student), a HealthTech extension, a cross-cutting vendor-side incident-disclosure spec, and a cross-cutting buyer-side procurement Decision Card. **One unified MCP server (60 tools, v0.6.0), one unified visualizer (11 renderers), 22 live subdomains, plus a 15-repo Suite Implementation Stack** (procurement-decision-api, policy-as-code-engine, audit-stream-py, hash-attestation-rs, aeo-validator-service, aeo-graph-explorer-rs, slo-budget-tracker, reliability-toolkit-rs, feature-flag-rs, request-shadow-rs, data-contract-registry, csv-data-quality-rs, incident-correlation-rs, mcp-reliability-toolkit, mcp-decision-intelligence) with four cross-ecosystem hooks.

## Part of the Kinetic Gain Protocol Suite

A family of **11 open JSON specifications** for the answer-engine and agent era — five core (AEO, Prompt Provenance, Agent Cards, AI Evidence Format, MCP Tool Cards), a three-spec EdTech trio (Tutor Cards / Student AI Disclosure / Classroom AI AUP), a HealthTech extension (Clinical AI Disclosure), a cross-cutting vendor-side Incident Card, and a cross-cutting buyer-side AI Procurement Decision Card. **Two regulated verticals covered. Bilateral (vendor disclosures + buyer decisions).**

- **Front door**: [suite.kineticgain.com](https://suite.kineticgain.com/)
- **Quickstart hub**: [docs.kineticgain.com](https://docs.kineticgain.com/)
- **Unified MCP server** (60 tools across 11 specs + 5 cross-cutting op categories, v0.6.0): [github.com/mizcausevic-dev/mcp-kinetic-gain](https://github.com/mizcausevic-dev/mcp-kinetic-gain)
- **Unified visualizer** (11 renderers): [github.com/mizcausevic-dev/kinetic-gain-visualizer](https://github.com/mizcausevic-dev/kinetic-gain-visualizer)
- **Meta-repo + Suite × Implementations catalog**: [github.com/mizcausevic-dev/kinetic-gain-protocol-suite](https://github.com/mizcausevic-dev/kinetic-gain-protocol-suite)
- **NIST AI RMF crosswalk v0.2**: [suite.kineticgain.com/docs/nist-rmf-crosswalk.md](https://suite.kineticgain.com/docs/nist-rmf-crosswalk.md)

## Implementation Stack (cross-ecosystem hooks)

1. `procurement-decision-api` → Suite docs (Suite × Decision Intelligence bridge)
2. `policy-as-code-engine` → `procurement-decision-api` (Decision Card → runtime PolicyBundle)
3. `data-contract-registry` → `procurement-decision-api` (Decision Card → contract Owner extraction)
4. `csv-data-quality-rs` → `data-contract-registry` (streaming CSV validator)

## Audit-stream spine (one log, seven producers, two ecosystems)

Every governance moment in the portfolio writes to one hash-chained, tamper-evident log via `audit-stream-py`. Producers fail safely — if the stream is down, governance still happens, the event is logged to stderr instead of the chain. Same opt-in env-var contract (`AUDIT_STREAM_URL`) across the whole spine.

- `procurement-decision-api` → `decision_card_drafted` (Python · FastAPI)
- `aeo-validator-service` → `watch_created`, `watch_drifted`, `watch_validity_flipped` (Python · FastAPI)
- `policy-as-code-engine` → `policy_bundle_registered`, `request_allowed`, `request_denied` (Python · FastAPI)
- `data-contract-registry` → `contract_promoted`, `contract_deprecated`, `contract_compatibility_failed` (Python · FastAPI)
- `hash-attestation` → `attestation_signed`, `attestation_verified`, `attestation_failed` (Rust · crypto library, `--features audit-stream`)
- `incident-correlation` → `incident_correlated`, `incident_correlation_failed` (Rust · graph library, `--features audit-stream`)
- `aeo-graph-explorer` → `graph_ingested`, `graph_ingest_failed` (Rust · axum service)

**17 event kinds across 7 producers**, all feeding one verifiable chain. `audit-stream-py` exposes SSE live tail, REST query, and `GET /verify` to walk the chain end-to-end for compliance evidence.
